title: These Villagers Wonder if They’re on the Front Line of Russia’s Shadow War
summary_full: Russia is accused of clandestine attacks on Ukraine’s allies in Europe, most notably at Leipzig/Halle airport in eastern Germany. That has changed life for villagers nearby.
